nodes.label: Agency Agents
nodes.rationale: Large role-based specialist catalog. STUDY/INTEGRATE. Role definition ≠ professional competence.

nodes.label: Conceptual Architecture Pipeline
nodes.rationale: USER REQUEST → Project/Environment Analyzer → Task Classifier → Capability Planner → Discovery/Registries → Decision Engine → Risk/Permission Check → Execution Adapter → Existing Runtime → Verification → Result. Keep initial implementation small.

nodes.label: DISCOVER → EVALUATE → COMPOSE → EXECUTE → VERIFY
nodes.rationale: Preferred lifecycle over building everything ourselves.

nodes.label: Make It Ezy
nodes.rationale: Free/open-source, local-first capability discovery and orchestration layer for the AI ecosystem. User describes outcome; system figures out process.

nodes.label: Model Provider
nodes.rationale: Model/inference provider: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama/local, others.

nodes.label: Orchestration Frameworks (Study Only)
nodes.rationale: Study but do not automatically adopt: LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Agno, LlamaIndex, Ruflo.

nodes.label: Phase 3 — Decision Engine
nodes.rationale: Natural-language goal → identify capabilities → discover/evaluate/rank candidates → dependencies/risks → recommend minimum useful composition with human-readable explanation.

nodes.label: Phase 4 — Installation and Runtime Adapters
nodes.rationale: ezy install with provenance/license/security disclosure; explicit approval for dangerous changes; never blindly execute untrusted install scripts.

nodes.label: Phase 5 — Verification
nodes.rationale: Verify outcome (build/tests/files/deps/errors/human review). Do not confuse agent saying finished with outcome achieved.

nodes.label: Phase 6 — Memory
nodes.rationale: Do not add vector DB by default. Memory only when demonstrated need: preferences, installed capabilities, successful workflows, trusted sources. Start with simple local config/files.

nodes.label: Phase 7 — Web UI
nodes.rationale: Do not begin with web UI. CLI/core proves concept first; UI consumes same APIs/core logic.

nodes.label: Repository Structure
nodes.rationale: apps/cli, packages/core, catalog, tests, docs/research, docs/architecture; pnpm workspace. Do not create dozens of empty packages.

nodes.label: Runtime
nodes.rationale: Environment that executes AI-assisted work: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, others.

nodes.label: Runtime Adapters
nodes.rationale: Adapters for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, future. Do not hard-code around one runtime.

nodes.label: Security Model
nodes.rationale: Treat skills as potentially executable/untrusted. Inspect source, scripts, deps, install, permissions, network, FS, credentials, reputation. High-risk ops need explicit confirmation. AI assistance ≠ professional authorization.

nodes.label: Specialist
nodes.rationale: Logical role or domain; does NOT necessarily mean a separate AI agent.

nodes.label: Technology Stack (Initial)
nodes.rationale: TypeScript, Node.js, pnpm, CLI-first, framework-light. Do NOT begin with Next.js, Electron, Rust, Python core, DB, vector DB, web UI, LangChain/LangGraph/CrewAI/AutoGen.

nodes.label: Tool
nodes.rationale: Something that performs an operation: Git, FFmpeg, browser, MCP server, CLI, API, etc.

nodes.label: MAKE-IT-EZY-MASTER-HANDOFF.md
nodes.rationale: Source-of-truth handoff for building Make It Ezy.

nodes.label: Cost Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Open-source ≠ free inference. Make model/API/provider costs visible; do not promise free AI when underlying service is paid.

nodes.label: Critical Product Principle
nodes.rationale: Optimize for smallest trustworthy combination of capabilities (usefulness + simplicity + trust + verifiability), not number of agents.

nodes.label: Existing Ecosystem First
nodes.rationale: Before new capability: search skills, workflows, tools, MCP, runtimes; evaluate quality/license/security/maintenance; reuse/integrate; build only when necessary.

nodes.label: Minimum Useful Composition
nodes.rationale: If same outcome achievable with fewer components, prefer simpler composition. Avoid unnecessary agents, DBs, orchestration, model calls, frameworks, cloud.

nodes.label: Vision: Local-First Capability Discovery
nodes.rationale: Help users answer: what skills, tools, workflows, and runtime should I use for outcome X? Prefer minimum useful combination over agent swarms.

nodes.label: What Make It Ezy Is NOT
nodes.norm_label: what make it ezy is not
nodes.rationale: Not chatbot, LLM, prompt library, agent marketplace/swarm, LangChain clone, package manager, skill format, MCP replacement, autonomous framework, subscription SaaS, or giant AI project database. It is a decision/discovery/composition layer.

nodes.label: What Make It Ezy Should BUILD
nodes.norm_label: what make it ezy should build

nodes.label: Agent Skills
nodes.rationale: Portable format/ecosystem for packaging reusable agent knowledge (SKILL.md, scripts, references, assets). Understand this format rather than inventing proprietary.

nodes.label: Capability
nodes.rationale: A thing that needs to be accomplished (write code, review code, generate captions, analyze SEO, etc.).

nodes.label: Development Workflow Sequence
nodes.rationale: UNDERSTAND → RESEARCH → BRAINSTORM → DESIGN → PLAN → TEST → IMPLEMENT → VERIFY → REVIEW. Superpowers for workflow; Agent Skills for specialized knowledge.

nodes.label: Layer A — Development of Make It Ezy
nodes.norm_label: layer a — development of make it ezy
nodes.rationale: Coding agent uses Superpowers, Agent Skills, UI/design, research, testing, architecture, code-review, browser tools while building the product.

nodes.label: Layer B — Make It Ezy Itself
nodes.norm_label: layer b — make it ezy itself
nodes.rationale: Finished product discovers, inspects, evaluates, compares, recommends, composes skills; connects tools; selects runtime; executes/hands off; verifies.

nodes.label: OpenSEO
nodes.rationale: SEO tooling/MCP/skills. INTEGRATE/OPTIONAL. External SEO data may incur provider costs.

nodes.label: Phase 0 — Ecosystem Research and Foundation
nodes.rationale: Avoid building wrong product. Research skills, workflow systems, agent catalogs, tools/orchestration, UI/design, SEO/RE, runtimes before significant implementation.

nodes.label: Phase 1 — Minimal CLI
nodes.rationale: ezy --help, ezy doctor (read-only env diagnostics), ezy analyze (read-only project analysis). No install/modify.

nodes.label: Phase 2 — Skill and Capability Discovery
nodes.rationale: ezy search; sources: GitHub, skills.sh, Vercel Skills, catalogs, local. Flow: DISCOVER → INSPECT → COMPARE → RECOMMEND. No automatic installation initially.

nodes.label: REA
nodes.rationale: Reverse engineering workflows. INTEGRATE/OPTIONAL. Potential Reverse Engineering capability.

nodes.label: Skill (Conceptual Model)
nodes.rationale: Reusable knowledge/instructions/resources/scripts; includes Agent Skill, Taste, UI UX Pro Max, SEO skill, testing skill.

nodes.label: Skill Discovery Model
nodes.rationale: Skill has identity, name, description, source, version, license, compatibility, runtime, dependencies, permissions, capabilities, inputs, outputs, risks, trust level, evidence.

nodes.label: Superpowers
nodes.rationale: Opinionated software-development workflow/methodology built around skills (brainstorming, planning, TDD, implementation, debugging, code review, verification, delivery). Not a required runtime dependency.

nodes.label: Taste
nodes.rationale: UI/frontend design skill. INTEGRATE/OPTIONAL. Potential UI/Design capability.

nodes.label: Workflow
nodes.rationale: Ordered or conditional process. Superpowers, GSD, BMAD belong largely here.

nodes.label: Research Deliverables
nodes.rationale: docs/research/{REFERENCE-DIRECTORY,RESEARCH-INVENTORY,PROJECT-COMPARISON}.md; architecture docs; ROADMAP; MVP-SPECIFICATION. Decisions: BUILD/REUSE/INTEGRATE/STUDY/OPTIONAL/IGNORE.
